title: Battle of Saint-Louis-du-Sud
text:
The Battle of Saint-Louis-du-Sud was fought on 22 March 1748 in the French colony of Saint-Domingue during the War of the Austrian Succession. A British Royal Navy squadron under the command of Admiral Charles Knowles attacked and destroyed a large French fort in Saint-Louis-du-Sud ,
then under the command of the interim Governor of Saint-Domingue, Étienne Cochard de Chastenoye.
